summary: vmware.vmware_rest removed deprecated appliance access modules (consolecli, dcui, shell, ssh and their info modules) and appliance networking DNS domains/hostname/servers modules.
questions: How do I enable SSH on the vCenter appliance after the upgrade?
Which vmware_rest appliance modules were removed?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest removed appliance access/DNS modules
answer_card.answer_md:
These `vmware.vmware_rest` modules/lookups were **removed** in Ansible 15 (vmware_rest PR #648). Remove them from playbooks or switch to `vmware.vmware` equivalents where available:

- `appliance_access_consolecli` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_access_dcui` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_access_shell` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_access_ssh` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_networking_dns_domains` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_networking_dns_hostname` (+ `_info`)
- `appliance_networking_dns_servers`
